key_results: Established one-to-one mapping between heterodeformations and soliton network geometry (line vector-Burgers vector pairs); moiré Bravais lattice insufficient—distinct heterodeformations can share identical lattices; framework enables direct construction of target networks
comments: Rigorous geometric framework for moiré interface design; inverse design route goes beyond conventional twist-based approaches and could enable engineering of superlubric interfaces.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Soliton network encodes interfacial multilattice geometry not captured by moiré Bravais lattice
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; many-to-one mapping shown for translational symmetry

hypotheses.hypothesis: Symmetry-broken networks exhibit anisotropic interfacial friction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tensorial friction demonstrated in designed bilayer graphene

title: Perinatal elimination of genetically aberrant human cortical neurons
task: Characterize somatic genomic variation in developing human neurons and identify quality-control mechanisms
key_results: 25.9% of prenatal cortical neurons have widespread copy number variants; this proportion reduced 4.5-fold postnatally (P = 3.5 × 10−6); neurons with high CNV burdens selectively eliminated and showed abnormal synaptic gene expression
comments: Single-cell whole-genome sequencing reveals a previously unappreciated developmental mechanism of genomic quality control through selective neuronal elimination based on dosage sensitivity.

model_io.model: Single-cell whole-genome sequencing (Tn5 and PTA methods)
inputs: 2,357 neurons from fetal to postnatal human cortex

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neurons with widespread CNVs are selectively eliminated perinatally
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; high-CNV neurons reduced 4.5-fold after birth, proportional to CNV burden

hypotheses.hypothesis: Elimination targets neurons with dosage-sensitive gene disruptions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; surviving neurons depleted for dosage-sensitive genes and neurodevelopmental disorder genes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Abnormal synaptic gene regulation mediates elimination of defective neurons
hypotheses.result: Supported; high-CNV neurons exhibit abnormal synaptic gene expression patterns

title: Connectome simulations identify a central pattern generator for fly walking
task: Identify central pattern generator circuit for fly walking
key_results: Three-neuron circuit (1 inhibitory, 2 excitatory interneurons) necessary and sufficient for motor rhythms across all six legs; DNg100 identified as strongest driver of rhythmic leg motor activity
comments: Elegant use of connectome-based simulation combined with optogenetic validation demonstrates how computational approaches can discover minimal functional circuits from connectivity data.

model_io.model: Drosophila ventral nerve cord connectome simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: DNg100 is the primary command neuron for walking-induced leg rhythms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DNg100 was strongest driver in computational screen

hypotheses.hypothesis: A minimal three-neuron circuit can generate motor rhythms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; isolated circuit sufficient across four connectome datasets

title: Presynaptic homeostasis mediated by exocytosis of a SNARE protein
task: Elucidate presynaptic homeostatic mechanism after high-frequency stimulation
key_results: VAMP7-mediated inhibition of P/Q-type Ca2+ channels reduces neurotransmitter release following high-frequency stimulation; absence of this homeostasis increases FOS+ neurons several-fold
comments: Novel identification of vesicle-associated SNARE proteins as activity-dependent regulators of presynaptic calcium channels provides mechanistic insight into metaplasticity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: VAMP7 mediates activity-dependent reduction in neurotransmitter release
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; VAMP7 inhibits P/Q-type channels to reduce release after high-frequency stimulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: VAMP7 localization to AP-3-derived vesicles enables activity-dependent delivery to plasma membrane
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; VAMP7 localizes to AP-3 vesicles responsive to high-frequency stimulation

title: Emotion regulation capacity lacks a shared neural signature
task: Determine neural basis of individual emotion regulation capacity
key_results: Across 2,175 participants in 40 fMRI datasets, trait questionnaires, task-based affective ratings, and amygdala down-regulation showed no convergence; SNP heritability of 16% (threefold higher than previous estimates) for AD
comments: Large-scale preregistered consortium study challenges the assumption that prefrontal activation reliably indexes emotion regulation ability, with important implications for clinical biomarkers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Canonical prefrontal regulatory circuits show consistent association with emotion regulation capacity across measures
hypotheses.result: Rejected; no convergence between trait, behavioral, and neural indicators

hypotheses.hypothesis: Prefrontal circuits are specifically engaged during emotion reappraisal
hypotheses.result: Rejected; control circuits engaged during both emotion generation and reappraisal

title: Alzheimer’s disease genetics converges on microglial and neuronal dysregulation
task: Identify genetic loci and molecular mechanisms underlying Alzheimer's disease
key_results: 118 loci identified in multi-ancestry analysis (48 novel); SNP heritability 16% (threefold higher than previous estimates); genes upregulated in microglia and downregulated in neurons enriched for AD-associated risk
comments: Substantially larger sample size and diverse ancestry analysis resolves prior underestimation of common-variant contribution to AD and highlights microglial-neuronal dysregulation as central mechanism.

inputs: SNP data from 183,620 cases and 2,631,507 controls

model_io.model: Gene expression analysis in AD brains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Common variants contribute substantially more to AD risk than previously estimated
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SNP heritability 16% vs prior estimates of ~5%

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microglial activation and neuronal dysfunction are central to AD pathogenesis
hypotheses.result: Supported; genes upregulated in microglia and downregulated in neurons enriched for AD risk

title: Integrated on-chip quantum light sources on a van der Waals platform
task: Integrate quantum light sources and waveguides on van der Waals bilayer platform
key_results: Strain-engineered bilayer WSe2 emitters coupled to WS2 waveguides; waveguide-coupled single-photon purity g^(2)(0)=0.003±0.003 (single-port) or 0.076±0.023 (cross-correlated); out-coupled rate ~357 kHz (estimated waveguide-coupled 1.68 MHz)
comments: Significant progress toward integrated quantum photonics but waveguide-coupling efficiency and single-photon purity remain well below theoretical limits; scalability to multiple emitters/detectors undemonstrated.

model_io.model: Bilayer WSe2 quantum emitters with strained sites coupled to multimode WS2 waveguides via grating couplers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strain-engineered quantum emitters efficiently couple to integrated van der Waals waveguides with high single-photon purity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: demonstrated g^(2)(0)=0.076±0.023 waveguide-coupled purity with 1.68 MHz estimated coupled rate

title: Bright and pure single-photon source in silicon by nanoscale positioning of a color center in a microcavity
task: Develop all-silicon single-photon source using W center in nanophotonic cavity
key_results: All-silicon source at 1217 nm with saturated count rate 1.29×10^6 counts/s; photon antibunching g^(2)(0)=0.06±0.02; triggered operation yields 93±2% purity; purity degradation at saturation attributed to repumping processes
comments: Significant advance for silicon quantum photonics but single-photon rate lower than cavity-enhanced NV centers; indistinguishability and scalability to coupled emitters remain open challenges.

model_io.model: Single W center in circular Bragg grating cavity embedded in silicon
inputs: cavity wavelength tuned to W center ZPL at 1217 nm

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nanoscale positioning of W center in cavity enhances zero-phonon line enabling high-purity on-demand single-photon emission
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: saturated 1.29×10^6 counts/s with 93±2% purity under weak pulsed excitation

title: Detector-mediated cross-spectral prediction with a gate-tunable van der Waals tunneling photodetector
task: Enable cross-spectral prediction using calibrated photodetector response as differentiable constraint
key_results: Visible-to-infrared prediction achieved PSNR 26.58 dB and SSIM 0.89; detector-response constraint reduces error relative to image-only baseline; post-inference measurements validate 64-mask response consistency after re-encoding
comments: Novel detector-mediated framework enforces physical consistency but applicability limited to materials with well-characterized tunable response; generalization to broadband sources unclear.

model_io.model: Neural network with differentiable gate-tunable PdSe2/h-BN/WSe2 photodetector response layer

hypotheses.hypothesis: Detector-response layer as differentiable constraint improves cross-spectral prediction by enforcing consistency with measured response manifold
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: detector-space error reduced relative to architecture-only control; post-inference measurements validate response consistency

title: Exciton-driven Floquet engineering from first principles
task: Predict Floquet band engineering driven by exciton dynamics from first principles
key_results: Monolayer h-BN shows subgap excitonic resonance generating clear Floquet sidebands and band renormalization via oscillatory excitonic field; effect persists without pump-probe temporal overlap
comments: Efficient first-principles framework combining TD-DFT and Floquet analysis is computationally practical; demonstration limited to single h-BN system; generalization to other materials requires validation.

model_io.model: Real-time TD-DFT with modified LRC kernel, Floquet-band analysis, and tr-ARPES simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oscillatory excitonic field acts as internal drive for Floquet engineering without direct laser dressing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: h-BN shows Floquet sidebands and band renormalization from excitonic dynamics; effect observable without pump-probe overlap

title: A single-molecule spin–photon interface
task: Develop single-molecule spin-photon interface using triplet ground-state carbene
key_results: Carbene molecule in host crystal exhibits narrow zero-phonon lines, >1-hour spectral stability, spin-selective optical transitions, millisecond-scale dynamical-decoupling coherence, tens-of-milliseconds spin relaxation at 4.5 K, single-molecule optically detected magnetic resonance
comments: Unprecedented molecular qubit platform combining bright fluorescence and long spin coherence; scalability to multi-qubit systems and room-temperature operation remain major challenges.

model_io.model: Triplet ground-state carbene molecule in structurally matched host crystal

hypotheses.hypothesis: Triplet carbene with structural host matching enables simultaneous bright fluorescence, spectral stability, and long spin lifetimes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: demonstrated narrow ZPLs, >1 hr spectral stability, ms-scale coherence, and 10s-ms relaxation times

title: Narrow carbon pentaheptite nanoribbon as a covalent metal
task: Synthesize metallic carbon pentaheptite nanoribbon with near-ballistic conductance
key_results: On-surface synthesis of planar carbon pentaheptite nanoribbons (CPHNs) via lateral fusion of polypentalene chains; CPHN 1 intrinsic metal with near-ballistic conductance approaching one conductance quantum (comparable to metallic CNTs); CPHN 2 narrow-bandgap semiconductor
comments: First demonstration of metallic pentaheptite nanoribbon with CNT-comparable conductance; device integration and synthetic yield optimization critical for practical carbon electronics.

model_io.model: On-surface synthesis with hierarchical polypentalene fusion and electronic transport measurement
inputs: thermal conditions for chain transformation and fusion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pentaheptite structure with alternating pentagon-heptagon rings enables intrinsic metallic conductivity with near-ballistic transport
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CPHN 1 exhibits near-conductance quantum, comparable to metallic carbon nanotubes

title: Subcycle videography of Landau–Zener–Majorana transitions in graphene
task: Visualize subcycle Landau-Zener-Majorana tunneling in graphene band structure
key_results: Attosecond-precision imaging of entire first Brillouin zone showing coherent subcycle displacement and distortion at zone edge; reveals non-thermal electron distributions and competing scattering processes
comments: Unprecedented subcycle band-structure videography but limited to graphene's relatively simple Dirac band structure; generalization to complex materials unclear.

model_io.model: Subcycle band-structure videography with photoelectron momentum microscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-adiabatic Landau-Zener-Majorana tunneling manifests as coherent carrier displacement at Brillouin zone edge
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: observed subcycle distortion and displacement consistent with periodic interband tunneling

title: Delayed electron–hole recombination in a pseudo-direct semiconductor
task: Demonstrate delayed electron-hole recombination in pseudo-direct bandgap semiconductor
key_results: Bismuth sulfide exhibits pseudo-direct nature (indirect transition lower in energy than direct transition by ~kBT); bimolecular recombination substantially retarded vs. classic direct semiconductors; high absorption coefficient + delayed recombination overcome van Roosbroeck-Shockley limitations
comments: Elegant demonstration of reciprocity circumvention via pseudo-direct gap but practical solar cell efficiency gains depend on minimizing other non-radiative loss pathways.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pseudo-direct bandgap character retards bimolecular recombination relative to direct bandgap semiconductors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: BiS2 shows substantially delayed recombination enabling combination of high absorption and long carrier lifetime

title: Time-reversal-symmetry-breaking spin injection from a compensated magnet
task: Generate spin currents from compensated magnet using altermagnetic order
key_results: Electrical spin injection from Mn5Si3 (compensated magnet, zero net magnetization) into non-magnetic channel detected at ferromagnetic electrode; switching between time-reversed magnetic states reverses spin signal; spin polarization 6.5-10% comparable to ferromagnets; spin diffusion lengths 50-130 nm
comments: First experimental demonstration of altermagnetic spintronic functionality without net magnetization; significant paradigm shift but only single material demonstrated; generalization to other alternalternagnets requires validation.

model_io.model: Mn5Si3 compensated magnet spin-valve device with lateral geometry
outputs: detected spin signal (reversed with magnetic state)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Altermagnetic order of compensated magnet enables spin-polarized current generation without net magnetization via time-reversal symmetry breaking
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: spin injection from Mn5Si3 demonstrated with 6.5-10% polarization; signal reversal with magnetic state confirms altermagnetic mechanism

title: Cometary impacts an unlikely pathway towards the origins of life on Earth
task: Assess cometary contribution to prebiotic feedstock delivery on early Earth
key_results: Rapid decline in cometary impact bombardment and efficient destruction of fragile organics during hypervelocity impact limit prebiotic molecule delivery; successful delivery was 'exceedingly rare event' not major source for origins of life
comments: Revisionist conclusion challenges decades of astrochemistry assumptions; relies on impact destruction modeling and short-period comet dynamics but long-period comet scenarios and chemical stability uncertainties remain.

model_io.model: Cometary impact simulations + comet-atmosphere interactions + dynamical evolution of short-period comets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cometary impacts delivered sufficient prebiotic feedstock for origins of life on early Earth
hypotheses.result: Rejected: rapid decline in bombardment and efficient organic destruction indicate 'exceedingly rare' successful delivery; not major pathway

title: Physics-informed impedance spectroscopy for diagnosing XLPE cable insulation aging based on a second-order Havriliak-Negami dielectric model
task: Diagnose XLPE cable insulation aging using physics-informed impedance spectroscopy
key_results: Second-order Havriliak-Negami model separates interfacial and dipolar relaxation; model-matching strategy estimates localized aging location; phase-based indicators characterize degraded region extent and severity; simulations demonstrate feasibility for non-destructive in-service assessment
comments: Physics-informed approach mechanistically interpretable but requires accurate frequency-dependent impedance measurements; localization precision and sensitivity to early-stage degradation need experimental validation.

model_io.model: Second-order H-N dielectric model with localized aging inverse problem
inputs: measured source-end input impedance Z(ω) over frequency range

hypotheses.hypothesis: Extracted dielectric parameters from impedance spectroscopy enable identification of dominant aging relaxation process and localization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in simulation: differentiated sensitivities to two relaxation contributions; model-matching approach successfully estimates position and phase indicators characterize severity

title: A high-performance CSP-DGM-SO-SD TFET photodetector with enhanced sensitivity and detectivity for visible-light applications
task: Design and optimize TFET photodetector for visible-light applications
key_results: CSP-DGM-SO-SD TFET achieves maximum sensitivity 5.8×10^5, LDCR 115.3 dB, responsivity 1.07×10^3 A/W, detectivity 2.07×10^10 Jones at 400-700 nm
comments: TCAD simulations show excellent performance metrics but lack experimental validation; gate-tunable response and temperature/dielectric dependence require device fabrication verification.

model_io.model: C-shaped dual-metal gate stacked-oxide sandwiched-drain TFET simulated in Synopsys Sentaurus TCAD

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stacked oxide geometry enhances photodetection sensitivity through improved band alignment and tunneling efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: simulation predicts 5.8×10^5 sensitivity with 115.3 dB LDCR in subthreshold region

title: Machine learning for advancing gamma source localization in a human phantom using NaI (Tl) detector spectra in radiobioassay
task: Localize gamma radiation sources in human phantom using ML on detector spectra
key_results: Logistic regression achieved 100% localization accuracy for GI organ (Co-60, Cs-137, Ba-133); decision tree reached 97.4% under same conditions; performance degraded for Ba-133 and whole-body detector due to spectral overlap and geometric symmetry
comments: Modular feature-based approach shows feasibility but limited by sparse dataset and detector geometry; clinical translation requires larger training sets and multiple detector configurations.

model_io.model: Four ML classifiers (LR, DT, SVM, MLP) trained per isotope-detector configuration
inputs: 10 statistical features (mean, skewness, kurtosis, entropy, IQR, etc.)
outputs: source organ location (GI, lung, thyroid, WB)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Statistical spectral features enable isotope-specific source localization via modular ML classification
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: LR/DT achieve high accuracy (97-100%) for favorable geometry; low-energy isotopes and symmetric geometries remain challenging

title: Hierarchical structure of primary and hybridization-induced superconducting correlations in bilayer nickelates
task: Determine microscopic pairing origin in bilayer nickelate superconductors
key_results: Primary pairing from Ni 3d_{z^2} orbital bonding-antibonding splitting; orbital hybridization redistributes correlations to d_{x^2-y^2} channel despite weak intrinsic pairing tendency
comments: Variational Monte Carlo analysis reconciles competing theories but relies on model assumptions about two-orbital Hubbard interactions.

model_io.model: Bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model with variational Monte Carlo

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbital hybridization redistributes superconducting correlations between d_{z^2} and d_{x^2-y^2} channels
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: comparable long-range correlations in both channels despite asymmetric intrinsic pairing tendencies

title: A nanoscale map of the human cell surface proteome reveals spatial and functional organization
task: Map spatial organization and functional modules of human cell surface proteome
key_results: Identified 85 surface antigens organized into functional modules; discovered mitochondrial proteins at plasma membrane; predicted IL-10 receptor β regulation of type I interferon signaling
comments: The transfer of mitochondrial proteins to cell surface and their functional relevance requires validation beyond proximity labeling, which can capture transient interactions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell surface proteome exhibits modular functional organization beyond known complexes
hypotheses.result: Identified novel clusters including mitochondrial proteins at plasma membrane

hypotheses.hypothesis: IL-10 receptor β subunit regulates type I interferon signaling
hypotheses.result: Machine learning model predicted this regulatory relationship from spatial association data

hypotheses.hypothesis: Surface antigens show distinct spatial organization patterns (dispersed vs. localized)
hypotheses.result: Spatial modeling distinguished active organization mechanisms governing antigen distribution
